q: How long does a typical project take?
a: Most projects run 4–8 weeks from first consultation to final installation, covering design, manufacture and fitting. Each discipline's own lead time is on its page.
Yes — a completely free, no-obligation home visit. We measure the space, photograph every wall, talk through how you use the room, and give you honest advice on what is worth doing.
We are based in Leicester and cover the whole of Leicestershire, including Oadby, Wigston, Market Harborough, Loughborough and the surrounding villages.

q: Can I choose my own materials and colours?
a: Absolutely. Each discipline has its own range of finishes, and we bring physical samples to your home so you can see them in your own light before anything is ordered.
Every installation carries a five-year workmanship guarantee, in writing, whichever service you choose.

q: Can you combine more than one service?
a: Often, yes, and it usually works out better. A bedroom and its wardrobes designed together share finishes, and one visit and one fit means less disruption than booking them separately.

q: How long does a kitchen installation take?
a: Typically 4-6 weeks from design approval to completion. Installation itself takes 3-5 days.

q: Do you remove the old kitchen?
a: Yes, we handle full removal and disposal of your existing kitchen as part of the project.

q: Can I keep my existing appliances?
a: Absolutely. We design around your existing appliances or help you choose new ones.

q: Can you work with sloped ceilings?
a: Yes! Fitted furniture is ideal for awkward spaces. We design around slopes and alcoves.
We offer over 100 finishes including wood grains, painted finishes, high gloss, and matt lacquer.

q: Can you integrate my existing fireplace?
a: Yes, we can design around existing features or install new electric/bio-ethanol fireplaces.

q: Will it support my TV size?
a: We engineer our media walls to support TVs up to 85 inches safely.

q: Can you fit wardrobes in alcoves?
a: Absolutely. Fitted wardrobes are perfect for making the most of alcoves and awkward spaces.
Most single wardrobes are fitted in a single day. Larger walk-in designs may take 2 days.
